scope: bounded deterministic logical event scheduling, total tie order and event-budget rejection; no physical clock, interrupt or hard real-time claim; native execution in fresh local handlers, SQLite SQL-function transactions and a bounded worker-thread dataflow pipeline; no cloud FaaS, arbitrary SQL, external stream or OS sandbox claim

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: read only named frozen candidates; no other filesystem, memory, network, tools or writes

runtimeControls: SQLite reopen recovery and rejected-result rollback
authorityProfile: local source/binary-bound job execution, frozen cases and unchanged fresh independent proposals; no new hosted CI

trials.intent: Sort events by increasing time, then increasing priority value, then increasing identifier, using a total deterministic order.
Reject an advance when the count of due active events exceeds the event budget; equality is allowed.
An external time proposal requires temporal commit capability equal to one and cannot move logical time backwards.
